title: spec/books: a book's synthetic *Uncategorized* group catches same-package docs a sibling book already claims, so two books over one package each list the other's pages under Uncategorized
body:
## Source

hotcrm#2327 (PR hotcrm#2355) measured this on HotCRM, platform 18.2.0. The report is hotcrm#2327 comment 6461000907.

The HotCRM app package ships two books over its own `src/docs/`:
- `crm_manual` claims `crm_overview`, `crm_sales_*` and the service package's `crm_service_*`.
- `crm_admin_manual` claims `crm_admin_*`, with `audience: { permissionSet: 'system_admin' }`.

Every doc is claimed by exactly one book, and `resolveBookClaimedDocs` per book agrees: hotcrm's `test/docs-books.test.ts` pins it. Even so, `GET /api/v1/meta/book/crm_manual/tree` as an administrator returns a trailing `uncategorized` group holding `crm_admin_access` and `crm_admin_automation`. The Admin Manual's tree likewise lists the app package's user pages under its own *Uncategorized*. Members without the admin set see neither, because the REST tree prunes by audience. The pages themselves are gated correctly.

## Mechanism (objectstack `main` `cbb3a1a1a`)

`resolveBookTree` (`packages/spec/src/system/book.zod.ts`, docblock above it) sends "any doc OF THE BOOK'S PACKAGES claimed by no group" to the synthetic *Uncategorized* group. "Claimed" is judged against this book's groups only. #20980 scoped the catch-all to the book's packages, but a doc a sibling book in the same package claims is still an orphan to every other book.

ADR-0046 §6.4 rolls up docs "left unplaced". A doc placed in a sibling book is not unplaced.

## Effect

An administrator opening the User Manual sees an *Uncategorized* section with the admin pages, which the Admin Manual already presents. Splitting one package's docs across books by audience, the case §6.7's per-book audience exists for, always produces this.

## Target

The orphan catch-all excludes docs that another registered book of the same package claims, which is the cross-book claim set `resolveDocAudiences` already builds by running `resolveBookClaimedDocs` over every book (`book.zod.ts:503–512`). A doc that no book claims still rolls up, as now.

## Acceptance

1. Two books over one package with disjoint includes: neither tree has an `uncategorized` group. A spec test pins this.
2. A doc of that package that neither book claims still appears under *Uncategorized* in the package's book(s).
3. The audience union (§6.7) is unmoved.

<sub>Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` lane seat (session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`) from hotcrm#2327's report. Dedupe: searched objectstack issues for book tree Uncategorized, sibling book and `resolveBookClaimedDocs`. #20980 (closed) scoped the catch-all to the book's packages, a different case. No open card.</sub>
